items.title: Lizzie Miles Interview, 1951-01-18
items.q: Miney Jones is the one that got that connection for me with Melrose.

ctx.x: What about Big Bill? Did you ever know Big Bill Brooms? Was he on any of his?
No. Miney Jones is the one that got that connection for me with Melrose. Miney Jones, who wrote Caledonia?
